name: Church of the Ascension, Kolomenskoye
description: The Church of the Ascension rises above the Moskva River at Kolomenskoye, a former royal estate now inside southeastern Moscow. Built in 1532 to celebrate the birth of the future Ivan the Terrible, it is one of the earliest Russian churches to top a stone and brick base with a soaring tent-shaped roof, a style that shaped churches across the country.
